title: Lock discipline: Lock mutates, RLock reads, comments state it
content: ARCHITECTURE RULE: every Store method carries a comment stating its lock level. Methods that mutate the map (including lazy expiry drops) take s.mu.Lock; pure reads take s.mu.RLock and MUST NOT mutate. New read endpoints (SessionsForUser etc.) follow the same discipline; the verifier runs -race with concurrent access.
